units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|As you leave your ship, you see a crowd watching a video screen not far from your landing spot. The video jumps between a panel discussion and footage of Admiral Danforth being quizzed by Parliament. It has finished by the time you arrive, and many of the onlookers have already left for their business. Two captains remain, however, and, by the sounds of it, they're having a passionate discussion about the video.|40|0
units.english: As you leave your ship, you see a crowd watching a video screen not far from your landing spot. The video jumps between a panel discussion and footage of Admiral Danforth being quizzed by Parliament. It has finished by the time you arrive, and many of the onlookers have already left for their business. Two captains remain, however, and, by the sounds of it, they're having a passionate discussion about the video.
units.italian: Mentre scendi dalla nave, vedi una folla che guarda uno schermo video non lontano dal punto di atterraggio. Il video salta tra una tavola rotonda e le riprese dell'ammiraglio Danforth incalzato dal Parlamento. Quando arrivi è già finito, e molti dei curiosi se ne sono già andati per i fatti loro. Restano però due capitani che, a sentire, stanno discutendo animatamente del video.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Hey. What was that video about?"|42|0
units.english: "Hey. What was that video about?"
units.italian: "Ehi. Di che parlava quel video?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	(Leave them be.)|43|0
units.english: (Leave them be.)
units.italian: (Lasciali stare.)

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	You're startled when the two captains turn to you, twin men with preposterous sideburns and rat-like mustaches. It's impossible to tell if they're smiling or frowning, as the pair live squarely in the middle of the uncanny valley.|45|0
units.english: You're startled when the two captains turn to you, twin men with preposterous sideburns and rat-like mustaches. It's impossible to tell if they're smiling or frowning, as the pair live squarely in the middle of the uncanny valley.
units.italian: Sussulti quando i due capitani si voltano verso di te: sono gemelli, con basettoni assurdi e baffi da topo. È impossibile capire se stiano sorridendo o aggrottando le ciglia, perché la coppia vive in pieno nella valle perturbante.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	The left twin asks, "Can you believe this? It's been weeks and everyone's still obsessing over the Pug invasion. The news was all experts and officials at first, but now we just see talking heads and conspiracy theorists."|46|0
units.english: The left twin asks, "Can you believe this? It's been weeks and everyone's still obsessing over the Pug invasion. The news was all experts and officials at first, but now we just see talking heads and conspiracy theorists."
units.italian: Il gemello di sinistra chiede: "Ci credi? Sono passate settimane e tutti sono ancora ossessionati dall'invasione dei Pug. All'inizio le notizie erano tutte esperti e funzionari, ora vediamo solo teste parlanti e complottisti."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	In disbelief, the right twin responds, "It's just a propaganda exercise to boost Syndicate sales. Even if these elusive 'Pug' existed, we won't hear the end of it as long as the story boosts public opinion of the Syndicate."|47|0
units.english: In disbelief, the right twin responds, "It's just a propaganda exercise to boost Syndicate sales. Even if these elusive 'Pug' existed, we won't hear the end of it as long as the story boosts public opinion of the Syndicate."
units.italian: Il gemello di destra risponde, incredulo: "È solo un esercizio di propaganda per gonfiare le vendite del Sindacato. Anche se questi sfuggenti 'Pug' esistessero, non la smetteremo di sentirne parlare finché la storia farà salire la popolarità del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"It was possibly the biggest event this century. Of course people are going to keep talking about it."|49|0
units.english: "It was possibly the biggest event this century. Of course people are going to keep talking about it."
units.italian: "È stato forse l'evento più grande del secolo. Ovvio che la gente continui a parlarne."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Oh, the Pug were real alright. I met some and fought them."|50|0
units.english: "Oh, the Pug were real alright. I met some and fought them."
units.italian: "Ah, i Pug erano veri eccome. Ne ho incontrati e ci ho combattuto."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"I think you both need to shave."|52|0
units.english: "I think you both need to shave."
units.italian: "Secondo me dovreste radervi, tutti e due."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	One twin rolls his eyes while the other twitches his mustache awkwardly. He rewinds the video to the Parliamentary discussion, where Danforth is reassuring councilors about the Navy's ability to patrol the fringes of human space.|54|0
units.english: One twin rolls his eyes while the other twitches his mustache awkwardly. He rewinds the video to the Parliamentary discussion, where Danforth is reassuring councilors about the Navy's ability to patrol the fringes of human space.
units.italian: Un gemello alza gli occhi al cielo mentre l'altro fa guizzare i baffi con imbarazzo. Riavvolge il video fino alla discussione parlamentare, dove Danforth rassicura i consiglieri sulla capacità della Marina di pattugliare i margini dello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	The left twin says, "Look at this bozo! Bounty's Councilor Maduena Kabiru, he keeps ranting against this Navy guy, uh, this Admiral..." He snaps his fingers trying to remember the name.|55|0
units.english: The left twin says, "Look at this bozo! Bounty's Councilor Maduena Kabiru, he keeps ranting against this Navy guy, uh, this Admiral..." He snaps his fingers trying to remember the name.
units.italian: Il gemello di sinistra dice: "Guarda questo pagliaccio! Il consigliere di Bounty, Maduena Kabiru, non fa che sbraitare contro questo tipo della Marina, ehm, questo ammiraglio..." Schiocca le dita cercando di ricordare il nome.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Admiral Danforth," says the right twin.|56|0
units.english: "Admiral Danforth," says the right twin.
units.italian: "Ammiraglio Danforth", dice il gemello di destra.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Right. Danforth. This councilor wants Danforth to defend against 'unknown dangers at the fringes of human space.' Don't we have enough immediate problems without imagining new horrors?"|57|0
units.english: "Right. Danforth. This councilor wants Danforth to defend against 'unknown dangers at the fringes of human space.' Don't we have enough immediate problems without imagining new horrors?"
units.italian: "Già. Danforth. Questo consigliere vuole che Danforth ci difenda dai 'pericoli sconosciuti ai margini dello spazio umano'. Non abbiamo già abbastanza problemi immediati senza immaginarne di nuovi?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Like terrorists nuking us," says the right twin.|58|0
units.english: "Like terrorists nuking us," says the right twin.
units.italian: "Come i terroristi con la bomba", dice il gemello di destra.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"The Navy is skilled and honorable. I trust them to protect us."|60|0
units.english: "The Navy is skilled and honorable. I trust them to protect us."
units.italian: "La Marina è capace e onorevole. Mi fido di loro per proteggerci."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"No, don't worry about that. I ended the bomb threat."|62|0
units.english: "No, don't worry about that. I ended the bomb threat."
units.italian: "No, non preoccuparti. Ho posto fine alla minaccia della bomba."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Maybe you're right."|65|0
units.english: "Maybe you're right."
units.italian: "Forse hai ragione."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"All we can do is get on with our lives, right?"|67|0
units.english: "All we can do is get on with our lives, right?"
units.italian: "Possiamo solo andare avanti con la nostra vita, no?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"If you don't shave soon, people will think you're wearing masks."|69|0
units.english: "If you don't shave soon, people will think you're wearing masks."
units.italian: "Se non vi radete presto, la gente penserà che portiate delle maschere."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	Both of them give hard belly laughs, sending waves through their mustaches from the breeze of their breath.|72|0
units.english: Both of them give hard belly laughs, sending waves through their mustaches from the breeze of their breath.
units.italian: Ridono entrambi di gusto, e i loro baffi ondeggiano nella brezza del loro stesso respiro.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	The left twin says, "Who are you, Admiral Danforts?"|73|0
units.english: The left twin says, "Who are you, Admiral Danforts?"
units.italian: Il gemello di sinistra dice: "E tu chi saresti, ammiraglio Danforts?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	His twin corrects him. "Danforth. Admiral Danforth. Did the Navy fire you or are you here on holiday?"|74|0
units.english: His twin corrects him. "Danforth. Admiral Danforth. Did the Navy fire you or are you here on holiday?"
units.italian: Il gemello lo corregge: "Danforth. Ammiraglio Danforth. La Marina ti ha licenziato o sei qui in vacanza?"
